meta.layer_selection: centres of k equal-depth bins; k=1 reproduces layer 16 of 32, the committed single-layer choice in hybrid_8b.py
meta.protocol: arms rms-matched per layer to the attention they replace; decay chosen on SELECT and reported once on VAL; every evaluated decay reported per arm; control-seed sweep at the SELECT-chosen decay
meta.environment: Quantized 4-bit 8B (mlx-community/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-4bit). The internal APFS volume is LOW ON FREE SPACE and the model is cached on an external ExFAT volume mounted at /Volumes/T9 (HF_HOME=/Volumes/T9/hf8b); nothing is downloaded to the internal disk. Weights are read through llm_hybrid.dense_weight(), which dequantizes packed uint32 4-bit weights -- reading .weight directly is a silent-corruption bug on this model.

1.control_seed_convention: committed hybrid_8b.py convention (np.random.default_rng(seed), no per-layer offset) -- k=1 is a direct replication of the single-layer run

2.control_seed_convention: one independent draw per (seed, layer): np.random.default_rng(seed*100003 + layer), so the k layers do not share a single random draw

4.control_seed_convention: one independent draw per (seed, layer): np.random.default_rng(seed*100003 + layer), so the k layers do not share a single random draw

8.control_seed_convention: one independent draw per (seed, layer): np.random.default_rng(seed*100003 + layer), so the k layers do not share a single random draw

16.control_seed_convention: one independent draw per (seed, layer): np.random.default_rng(seed*100003 + layer), so the k layers do not share a single random draw

verdict.summary: transfer wins at 1 of 5 k values; see per-k margins rather than a single claim
verdict.hypothesis_under_test: if the 8B null is caused by redundant surviving attention layers routing around the damage of ONE replaced layer, then replacing more layers should reduce that redundancy and the transplant-minus-random margin should GROW with k, tracking the deletion cost
verdict.interpretation_rule: gap grows with k -> the single-layer 8B test was underpowered and the 1B effect is present at 8B once the intervention is large enough. gap flat or negative while the deletion cost grows -> the 1B effect does not scale; the NULL is the finding
verdict.caveat: a growing deletion cost is not by itself evidence for the transplant: the zero arm moving further from the teacher proves the intervention is larger, and only the transfer-minus-control margin speaks to whose weights are better
